newsitem.title: JAPAN: Full-fledged Japan economic recovery in sight - EPA.
newsitem.headline: Full-fledged Japan economic recovery in sight - EPA.

text.p: Japan's Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Shusei Tanaka said on Thursday that a complete economic recovery led by domestic demand was now in sight.

"Domestic demand remains firms, and a full-fledged recovery led by domestic demand is now in sight," Tanaka said in a speech read by EPA Vice Minister Shinpei Nukaya. "But this does not mean that the economy has already started a full recovery.

"There are worrying factors such as severe employment conditions, which must be considered in predicting the future course of the economy," he said. The government would pay close attention to exchange rates and employment, he added.
